description: Full-day schedule for a route — all trips, stop sequences, and departure times for the specified date (defaults to today). Returns up to all trips for the route. For live predictions, use onebusaway_get_arrivals at specific stops instead.

anyOf.description: A real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form (e.g. "2026-05-23").

date.description: Service date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2026-05-23"). Must be a real calendar date. Omit or leave blank for today.

routeId.description: Agency-prefixed route ID (e.g. "1_100259"). Use onebusaway_find_routes or onebusaway_search_routes to discover IDs.

name: onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route

date.description: Date parameter used for the schedule request, if specified.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `route_not_found`: Route ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no trips were found — e.g. no service on weekends or holiday schedule in effect.

tripCount.description: Number of trips for this route on this date.

trips.description: All trips for this route on this date, with their stop sequences.

items.description: A single trip with its scheduled stop sequence.
A stop time along this trip.

arrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

departureTime.description: Scheduled departure time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

tripId.description: Trip ID for follow-up onebusaway_get_trip calls.

title: Get Route Schedule
